messages.subject: issue-70 research plan complete
messages.body: Wrote .m4/issue-70-plan.md covering all 7 required sections: a new transport-http contract family at 0.4.x (lekalo/transport-http/v0.4.x schema, transport_http core module, lekalo transport CLI, node-typescript generate extension, conformance check additions, fixtures and Ajv gate). Scope: new contract + diagnostic family + capability/component registry increments + canonical lekalo/transport.yaml home feeding .lekalo/cache/transport evidence into the existing generate pipeline; Model/IR/scenario/error/query contracts unchanged. Biggest risk: the domain-transport boundary — the plan single-sources method/path in the Model endpoint symbol and projects #62 error identity into wire envelopes, but the canonical-home structure-contract edit and closed-catalog conformance increments need owner review.
